judge_claim: PrivXPO and SquareXPO are the first online algorithms for private and robust preference alignment, and PrivXPO has suboptimality O(c(epsilon)sqrt(log(|Pi|T)/T)).

subclaims.first_online_private_and_robust_alignmen: not contradicted by the audited pre-paper corpus

falsification_contract: identify a public work dated before the target paper
require an online pairwise-preference alignment protocol
require local differential privacy on labels before learner disclosure
require a theoretical online performance guarantee
acceptance: implement the named PrivXPO objective on a finite policy class
independently reconstruct the c/sqrt(T) theorem substitution
verify all falsification-contract fields against primary sources
